name: yamlSerialize
description: Serializes a CFML value (struct, array, or scalar) to a YAML string and returns it. When a file path is supplied, the YAML is also written to that file. Struct keys beginning with two underscores are skipped, mirroring serializeJSON. The charset argument is accepted but ignored (output is UTF-8).

params.name: data
params.description: The CFML value to serialize to YAML.

params.name: filePath
params.description: Optional file path to also write the YAML string to.

params.name: charset
params.description: Character encoding (accepted for compatibility; output is always UTF-8).

examples.title: Serialize and write to a file
examples.description: The YAML string is returned and also written to the file.
